messages:
irma cole: Quick thread for Priya Shah's final loop on Thu 2026-08-12. Shes requesting childcare reimbursement for the day and ID verification help at check-in. Who owns childcare approvals?
ben foster: I can help with childcare reimbursement — policy allows up to $200/day with receipts for onsite candidates. Finance approval needed for pre-payments.
jordan kim: Facilities can do front-desk ID verification and escort. We need full name as on ID and expected arrival time.
irma cole: Arrival 09:45 SFO, plans to stay onsite 10:3015:30. Full name: Priya Shah. She asked if we can hold her ID overnight for HR background check drop-off. Is that allowed?
people-ops-bot: Background check policy: we do NOT hold personal IDs overnight. Candidate may present ID at check-in; HR can scan/verify and return immediately.
ben foster: Noted. For childcare: do we reimburse nanny invoices or will we pre-pay a voucher? Candidate prefers reimbursement.
finance-bot: Reimbursement flow: candidate submits nanny receipt via Expensify within 7 days, tag "candidate-childcare", Finance will auto-approve up to $200/day. For pre-pay, submit Travel/Expense Request -> https://redwood.internal/travel with reason "candidate childcare".
irma cole: OK we'll ask Priya to keep receipts and we'll add the reimbursement note to the invite. Jordan, can you confirm front-desk will do same-day ID scan only?
jordan kim: Confirmed. Front desk will scan and return ID immediately. Escort assigned: Desk volunteer Kelly will meet at 09:40. Room reserved: 4th Floor, Conf C (quiet).
irma cole: She also requested a place to pump (lactation) and a low-sensory waiting area for her toddler. Facilities?
facilities-bot: Lactation Room L2 reserved 10:00-16:00. We can arrange a quiet corner in the visitor lounge and provide a childcare mat. Note on allergies: request for latex-free mat?
irma cole: Candidate is allergic to latex, please use latex-free mat. I'll add that to the packet.
ben foster: I'll DM Priya about receipts and the reimbursement workflow. Also will CC finance contact for visibility.
jordan kim: Small logistics: loaner laptop (MacBook Air) pre-cloned with hiring repo, and parking pass for visitor lot B printed.
irma cole: Add "remote fallback" in invite: if toddler care falls through last minute, panels can run remote; hands-on can be rescheduled for a later date.
finance-bot: One more: if candidate needs last-minute childcare due to travel delays, we can approve same-day reimbursement if receipts are provided and manager signs off.
irma cole: Great. I'll send invite with childcare reimbursement note, ID check instructions, lactation room details, and parking info. Thanks everyone. :heart:
